verdict.rationale: The docs show a one-line CLI deploy (`npm i -g netlify-cli`, then `netlify deploy --allow-anonymous`) that publishes straight from the working directory without logging in, and the official CLI is documented. Nothing shows a CLI command that scaffolds a new project, let alone one that scaffolds and deploys in a single step; starter templates appear only as integration-directory listings. Missing for 10: a CLI scaffolding/init-from-template command, a combined scaffold-and-deploy in one command, and independent hands-on confirmation of the single-command flow.
